cooked: The on-disk format boundary deserves particular scrutiny: Core tools and recovery code assume the usual block-file framing, so a compressed record needs an unambiguous discriminator that cannot be mistaken for a legacy size or payload. I’d also test truncated writes and restart/reindex after crashes at each point in the record write; matching a fully built chain won’t cover those failure modes.
